expect_red: a body press that writes reads pending in the click itself, before the pane answers; while it writes every writing control waits; a failure stays on its control

mutations.contract: A feature body's control that writes (Keep, Unbind, Take, ...) reads the pending word and is disabled in its own click, before anything crosses to the pane: the write it starts took 10-40 s on the pitch plate, and the only thing that changed on the page meanwhile was the focus ring.
mutations.note: Drops the click's own mark, so the pressed control looks unpressed until the page repaints -- the state the walk's shots 02c and 02e show.
